analysis.title: GS Duttenhoefer - Duttenhoefer's Daily 21.10.2026
key_insights: S&P 500 rose 28bps to 7713 (+12.7% ytd) with 403 of 500 stocks higher. The US 10-year yield was unchanged at 5.12%. Brent returned above $110 after Houthi attacks on Saudi facilities. Gold is at $4115 and Bitcoin at $83k.
Tesla and SpaceX have each formed special committees of independent directors to review a possible merger. Per Musk, the committees were created at shareholders' request.
US margin debt rose $26.2bn in September to the second-highest month-end reading in FINRA's series, after June's $1.502tn. Balances are up $254.5bn (+20.8%) since December 2025.

Netflix fell 5% after the close. The 4Q revenue, operating income and EPS guides are below the Street. The FY FCF guide was cut from $12.5bn to about $12bn, attributed to a real estate transaction. The FY26 ad revenue guide is about $2.7bn versus about $3bn before, because some ad products are rolling out more slowly than expected. Management acknowledged US engagement has room for improvement. GS cut its price target from $90 to $84.

The global average crude freight rate rose above $20/bbl from $3/bbl a year ago. Rates on Middle Eastern routes are above $35/bbl. GS analyzes the drivers and the implications for crude producers and refiners.

Cyber attacks are spreading: hackers raised the temperature in refrigerators at hundreds of French supermarkets and ruined the food. GS points to its 16-stock Cyber basket (Palo Alto, CrowdStrike and others), ticker GSTMTCYB Index.

Ledger hardware crypto wallets were compromised in the supply chain. Attackers added a small chip with a key logger and a SIM card and returned the devices to the reseller channel, which allowed theft of more than $100m.

China is expanding autonomous delivery. Shenzhen opened nighttime deliveries to driverless vehicles. Meituan's ground vehicles completed more than 5.5m outdoor delivery orders and logged more than 19m autonomous kilometers by end-2025. JD.com plans to procure 3m robots, 1m unmanned vehicles and 100k drones over 5 years. The author's view: physical AI is real.

The GS EU Quality basket (GSPEQUAL), a pair of High Quality (GSXEHQLT) versus Low Quality (GSXELQLT), gained 8% over the past month after a long stretch of underperformance. High quality is defined by low leverage, high profitability and high earnings/sales stability. GS sees substantial room for a catch-up trade.

The GS global themes and baskets email says to buy the broadening: SPXXAI has outperformed the S&P 500 by 586bps since Oct 6. GS continues to favour quality (GSP1QUAL), but stretched technicals (RSI above 80) imply scope for a sharp reversal if inflation and rate concerns ease. It also recommends long ACA-Exposed Beneficiaries (GSHLCACA) as a defensive mid-terms trade.

GS raised its end-2026 copper forecast to $14,700/t from $13,735/t and its 2027 average forecast to $15,400/t from $13,800/t. Mine supply is weaker than expected, ex-US deficits are now expected to be larger, and US-China competition and a higher positioning assumption also feed the forecast.

Musk said Terafab's output value would place it in the top 20 of a country's GDP in a single building. It will be 2.5 miles long and 100 million square feet, with a first-phase cost of $16.8bn. It will make chips for self-driving vehicles, humanoid robots, and orbital and terrestrial data centers.
DDR5 pricing rose 7% m/m in September and trades at a 20% premium to September contract pricing.
GS total power demand CAGR rises to 3.5% through 2030, driven by both behind-the-meter and front-of-the-meter data center demand.

Meta, Tesla, SAP, IBM, Texas Instruments and Lam Research report earnings today. South Korean neocloud Elice rose 30% after a 30% fall on its IPO debut the day before, with the offering more than 300x oversubscribed.
